name: After § 216
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 216 a. Calls on the Commission to: (a) provide Parliament with clear, public and verifiable evidence from the Palestinian Authority demonstrating the removal of all antisemitic, hateful and violent content from textbooks and teacher guides in active classroom use; (b) scrutinise Union funding made available to the Palestinian Authority and suspend all funding that contributes directly or indirectly to the drafting, teaching or disseminating educational materials that promote antisemitism, hatred and violence;
